name: [RELEASE] Hollow Era
desc:
NEXT CODE AT 70K LIKES!

Be a Soul Reaper in a world where people keep living as a soul after their death.
Get stronger to defeat Hollows, or become one.

Level cap = 100

Default Controls:
MB1 - Basic Attack
F - Block
E - Equip
2xW - Sprint
Q - Dash
Z X C - Mode Skills
V - Ultimate Mode Skill
0-9 - Special Skills
M - Menu
Y - Modes
J - Reveal objectives
Middle Mouse Button - Lock On

Gamepasses and EXP/Money multipliers are shared between slots.
